text_block_list.text:
One day, Epiphaneia called for me, and I 
headed over to the park.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm gonna take on the challenge— 
of riding the bicycle I never could ride 
before!
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, you weren't good with 
that, were you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, honestly I was avoiding it. It's 
actually slower when an Umamusume rides 
it, and if I'm going out, I'd rather just 
run myself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in class told me, "It's no big 
deal if you can't ride a bike," too. Even 
so—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Being able to do it is better than not! 
It'll open up your options!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've grown, I feel like I can do 
it. Watch me, Trainer!

Epiphaneia triumphantly pedals off on the 
bicycle. She smoothly picks up speed, 
and...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh~~~!?
(THUDDDD!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I totally wiped out! Still, I feel 
like I'll get the hang of it if I keep 
trying!

Even after taking a spill, Epiphaneia 
remains as eager as ever. Isn't there some 
way I could ride him—
choice_data_list: Any idea why you can't ride?

Why don't we listen to advice from all 
sorts of people?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The reason for not riding... Ah! I 
actually have an idea about that!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can't ride because I fall off! Which 
means, as long as I don't fall, I'm good!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We just need to thoroughly train your 
sense of balance!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tackle the rough terrain while holding 
this! Without spilling a single drop of 
water, of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Sei! Torya! Yo!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa... whoops! Phew~~, that was close!
choice_data_list: Incredible, not a single drop spilled...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Next, endure the waves while holding the 
cup! Come on, bring it on!!
(SPLAAAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Phaaaah! I endured it~~~!

text_block_list.name: Dog on a Walk
text_block_list.text: Bow-wow! Bow-wow!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're full of energy! Hey, perfect 
timing! Race me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Take this, take that, take thaaat--!!

Epiphaneia managed to get through the 
entire day without spilling a single drop 
of water. This time, she might finally be 
able to ride a bicycle...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I get it now. If I still can't ride 
it after all this, that means—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Not being able to ride a bike is who I 
am! There's no need to twist myself into 
something else!"

The next day, during training, Epiphaneia 
seemed different from usual—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! How's the clock look, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: You're getting faster little by little...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, gotcha! I'll take my own two legs 
over a bicycle any day!!

As a result of honing her sense of 
balance, it had a positive impact on her 
running!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm so glad I realized it! I'm so 
glad I gave it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep giving it everything I've got, 
head-on, with just my own body!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I can expect great things from your 
serious effort! I'm counting on you!

The reason Epiphaneia can't ride a bike 
well is that she relies purely on momentum 
to get moving. I should teach her how to 
brake and steer properly.

"First, I want her to learn how to stay 
still. To that end, I decided to have her 
try fishing."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, got a bite! Nnnghh! It's a big one, 
Trainer!!
choice_data_list: Don't pull so hard, stop for a second!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Endure it, endure it, endure it—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaah!!!!
choice_data_list: I'm not holding up at all!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's insanely huge! This is what you 
wanted, right?!

"Since I ended up catching a huge one, 
there's not much I can say... We should 
probably try the next method."

"Let's fundamentally teach you to 'operate 
with a calm mind.' To that end, I've 
prepared a game."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Character creation complete! Now, let's 
head out on an adventure!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is smash the monsters and 
hit the goal, right?! Piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're here! Attack! Attack! Attack! 
Attack!

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Fgaaaah!! Gaaah!!!!
choice_data_list: It's not working! Let's run for now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I won't turn my back! Nothing but forward 
momentum while attacking!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh! Mash, mash, mash the dash 
button~~!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeaaah! Cleared ittt!! With my power, 
I can push through anything!
choice_data_list:
If that's the case, a bicycle might be 
tough...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I'll ride the bike with sheer 
momentum! Let's play and train even more, 
Trainer!

Maybe she really can ride solely on 
momentum. Epiphaneia was brimming with 
enough energy to make anyone believe it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah, a pitfall!? Wahhh, it's game over!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next! —Wait, another pitfall 
trap~~~?!

The day Epiphaneia rides a bicycle still 
seems far away. Still, she looks like she 
had fun today, so let's call it a win!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! With everyone's help, I feel 
like I can ride it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Epi-saaan, Trainer-saaan! I got the 
training wheels screwed on super tight!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! I'll be supporting you 
from behind, so you should be able to run 
safely♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're so dependable...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What's important are the brakes and the 
steering! Slam on the brakes like 
screeech, turn gently like whoosh, and 
it's a piece of cake♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Gripping firmly! And then gently floating! 
Alright, I think I've got the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, your mindset! Please believe in 
yourself and know that you can ride!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm good at that! Alright, here I gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooo--!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You're going way too fast! Brake, brake!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh~~~!?

Braking abruptly causes Epiphaneia to be 
thrown into the air...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, just lightly, like this... Like giving 
it a gentle squeeze...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Please hold back your strength! Don't use 
momentum, squeeze it out gently...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa... ooooh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Your body might be bending too much this 
time. It's important to keep straight from 
head to hips, so—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Do you really need to overthink it so 
much? You sit down, right? You pedal, 
right? Doesn't it just move forward like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Who knew you needed so much 
knowledge for a bicycle!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You'd better stop this! The voice of 
destiny is telling me so, too...!
